items.title: Don Alias interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002
items.q: When I came back in the band he had come back. He was a great singer for that type of stuff.

ctx.x: David Clayton Thomas was gone at that time, wasn’t he?
He had come back. When I came back in the band he had come back. He was a great singer for that type of stuff.
